name: Hurting Others
overview: Scripture reveals that while people may intend harm, God can use those actions for good, as seen in Joseph's story where evil plans were transformed to save many lives (Genesis 50:20). The Lord draws near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite, offering healing and restoration to their wounds (Psalms 34:18; 147:3). God hates actions that cause harm and abhors sinful behaviors (Proverbs 6:16), and He teaches that gentle, wise speech can prevent anger, while careless words can provoke it (Proverbs 15:1; 18:21). Thus, believers are called to exercise careful speech and trust God's redemptive power over the pain caused by others.
